evidence: Touches fuzzing utilities and harnesses in src/test/fuzz/util/net.* and multiple fuzz targets under the Fuzzing label.
rationale: Improves fuzzing fidelity across multiple networking targets by correcting mock socket collisions and modeling realistic OS socket behaviors. Prior to this, 'every FuzzedSock had one of two socket values and CConnman::SocketHandler() merged the entries of different peers in a single wait', causing misleading test execution and missing error paths for partial events and connection resets.
